name: Aprepitant
summary: Aprepitant, sold under the brand name Emend among others, is a medication used to prevent chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting and to prevent postoperative nausea and vomiting. It may be used together with ondansetron and dexamethasone. It is taken by mouth or administered by intravenous injection. A prodrug, fosaprepitant, is also available for intravenous administration.

combinations.note: Listed as a significant drug interaction on Wikidata.

pharmacology.text: Aprepitant is classified as an NK1 antagonist because it blocks signals given off by NK1 receptors. This, therefore, decreases the likelihood of vomiting in patients. NK1 is a G protein-coupled receptor located in the central and peripheral nervous system. This receptor has a dominant ligand known as Substance P (SP). SP is a neuropeptide, composed of 11 amino acids, which sends impulses and messages from the brain.

body.says: Liver (mostly CYP3A4- mediated; some contributions by CYP2C19 & CYP1A2)

uses.text: Aprepitant is used to prevent chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting and to prevent postoperative nausea and vomiting. It may be used together with ondansetron and dexamethasone.

sideEffects.text: Common side effects include tiredness, loss of appetite, diarrhea, abdominal pain, hiccups, itchiness, pneumonia, and blood pressure changes.

summaryZh: 阿瑞匹坦（英語：Aprepitant），是一種用於預防化療引起的噁心和嘔吐，以及預防手術後噁心和嘔吐的藥物。它可與昂丹司瓊（一種減少手術、化療、放射治療後噁心與嘔吐的藥物）和地塞米松（常被用作抑制或防止藥物過敏反應的藥物）一起使用。此藥物經口服或靜脈注射方式給藥。
summaryZhHans: 阿瑞匹坦（英语：Aprepitant），是一种用于预防化疗引起的恶心和呕吐，以及预防手术后恶心和呕吐的药物。它可与昂丹司琼（一种减少手术、化疗、放射治疗后恶心与呕吐的药物）和地塞米松（常被用作抑制或防止药物过敏反应的药物）一起使用。此药物经口服或静脉注射方式给药。

fact.en: It blocks the receptor for substance P, a signalling peptide discovered in 1931 and named simply after the dried powder the researchers had made of it.
fact.zh: 阿瑞匹坦阻斷 P 物質的受體。P 物質是 1931 年發現的訊號胜肽，名稱單純取自研究人員當時製成的乾燥粉末（powder）。
fact.zhHans: 阿瑞匹坦阻断 P 物质的受体。P 物质是 1931 年发现的信号胜肽，名称单纯取自研究人员当时制成的干燥粉末（powder）。
